srcLineNum.description: The number of line (starting from 1) in the test file that caused the problem (if any from stacktrace).

message.description: The error message. e.g., if a java exception is thrown, the return value of getMessage()

type_.description: The type of error that occurred. e.g., if a java exception is thrown the full class name of the exception.

title: A failure is a test which the code has explicitly failed by using the mechanisms for that purpose. e.g., via an assertEquals.
name: TestFailure
